name: aeqSurv
title: Adjudicate near ties in a Surv object

origin.description: Map times that all.equal would treat as tied onto one cut.
origin.details: Map times that all.equal would treat as tied onto one cut.
origin.value: A Surv response whose times are the retained cuts.

translation.description: Map times that all.equal would treat as tied onto one cut.
translation.details: Map times that all.equal would treat as tied onto one cut.
translation.value: A Surv response whose times are the retained cuts.
translation.example:
from survival import Surv, aeqSurv

def one():
    s = aeqSurv(Surv([1, 1 + 1e-10, 5], [1, 1, 0]))
    lines = [f"{value:.17g}" for value in s.columns[:, 0]]
    lines += [f"{value:.17g}" for value in s.columns[:, 1]]
    return lines

print("\n".join(one()))
